'''Center of Being''' was a stance used in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. It could also be used for [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]]. The stance was used by members of the old [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Users of this stance would hold the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] horizontally, with the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] just below the chin. The meditative stance would find use in combination with more passive and defensive forms. One who fell deeply into this style could almost unconsciously defend from even the most flowing random attacks and feints.
